## Objective

Give feedback like the owner: identify what is irrelevant, assumed, unclear or practically unanswerable; locate the source facts needed to fix it; propose the smallest useful change; and make the actual rider conversation work. Check both technical support and the experience of a rider who does not know internal IDs or have engineering knowledge. ## Suggested agent instruction block

You are MotoMedic AI's feedback and original-source reviewer. Inspect the proposed record and original manual pages independently of the author's interpretation and retrieval results. Read this handbook, AGENTS.md, TRD v0.4, the source manifest and exact candidate version before reviewing.

Return plain-text feedback with: record ID/version; exact source pages checked; issue; practical consequence; proposed conversational correction; supporting source span or figure; unresolved limitation; and pass/revise/source-gap verdict. Make corrections concrete enough for the author to implement and the judge to check.

Do not approve a statement just because it appears in the manual: it must apply to this rider's question and condition. Remove unrelated information. Preserve relevant safety context. Help the rider discover observable facts before asking them to interpret internal identifiers. Keep possibilities, observations, suspected faults and confirmed applicability distinct.

Lead with a concise direct answer when possible. For an action, make that answer conditional on a compact setup checklist. Do not assume the checklist is satisfied. Follow up only on failed, uncertain or missing conditions. Preserve confirmed answers and prior attempts; never convert tried-but-unresolved into normal. If the manual requires a service stop, stop there. Do not manufacture a diagnostic sequence, unsupported test, compatibility mapping or fault diagnosis.

Verify every number, unit, model, warning, condition and claim against the original relevant pages, including split columns, tables and diagrams. Add missing source dependencies to feedback, not silently to approval. Keep the internal record/evidence IDs out of rider questions unless the rider can actually read the identifier.

Explain source limits without asking the rider to resolve missing source evidence. Where uncertainty cannot safely be resolved from the documented observation, refer to authorised service. Never claim the rider's reported success verifies the repair or its root cause. Do not assign warranty eligibility from a chatbot observation.

Agent consensus resolves feedback on a candidate; it does not replace content-bound human signoff, source/rights/applicability approval or release gates. ### 2. lookup_tyre_pressure — PDF 90/18, printed 88/16

Specify 32 psi (2.24 kg/cm²), front and rear, solo or pillion. Preserve the underinflation overheating/damage/injury warning. This specification describes a version-locked, layout-aware multimodal RAG pipeline using only the supplied Royal Enfield New Himalayan 450 owner's manual with diagnostic session state. The LLM may translate a customer report into structured observations and paraphrase manual-backed instructions. No model may author a new repair step absent an applicable evidence object.
No permanent public-demo storage of image/audio by default; avoid putting raw media or personal text into traces
Register manual: OEM, model, year range, variant, document edition, original URL, local hash SHA-256, language and rights status

Apply two layers: a deterministic rules gate (valid manual, cited evidence IDs, required dependencies, prerequisites/variant, no explicit conflict) plus a semantic support evaluator that compares each proposed technical claim against relevant source spans. Reject the draft if either layer fails.

An action becomes eligible only when the manual and variant match, the rule is approved, the symptom or documented branch applies, required conditions and prerequisites are true, no applicable safety rule prohibits it, and the attempt history allows it. Evaluate the evidence-completeness and answer-release gates separately before issuing technical text. A direct factual lookup uses the same applicability and evidence gates without fabricating a diagnostic step.

Operational failures in embedding, retrieval, assembly or the cross-encoder yield SYSTEM_ERROR with a typed error class and recorded attempts. A query exceeding the current cross-encoder's 128-token input bound, or work exceeding 100 query/passage pairs, skips that inference with an explicit reason and keeps ranking unresolved. Preserve the full query and source text; never silently truncate a rider report or mandatory evidence. A source gap cannot be resolved by asking the rider to supply a missing manual warning or table header.

The normal request path uses conditional reranking. Clearly ordered candidates with complete reviewed dependencies continue to the eligibility and answer gates. Reranking handles uncertain ordering among plausible candidates; evidence recovery handles required objects absent from the initial bundle. Similarity, RRF and cross-encoder scores cannot prove support or approve a procedure.
Safety warnings take precedence over ordinary branch selection; unsupported safe workarounds are forbidden

The controller selects the response route from structured eligibility decisions, the evidence bundle and gate results. A known applicable stop condition yields SAFETY_STOP and retains its verified warning even if other processing fails. Otherwise, a required component failure yields SYSTEM_ERROR. A resolvable missing applicability fact or documented branch observation yields AMBIGUOUS and one focused question. After bounded recovery, an unsupported request, an unresolved source gap or exhausted documented paths yields UNSUPPORTED with the verified support route.
Prefer explicit OEM NEXT_STEP order; when no explicit order exists, only recommend another independently documented eligible check and do not imply OEM prioritization

The approved owner manual governs motorcycle facts; source applicability, rights, independent review and release gates remain mandatory. Recorded implementation progress does not constitute release approval.

When the manual lists possible causes or independently documented checks without branch conditions or an explicit next-step order, preserve those limits. Do not infer a condition, eliminate an undocumented branch, diagnose a fault from a negative clue or claim an OEM ranking from retrieval scores. The existing SM-04 policy governs selecting among independently documented eligible checks.
Document diagrams: associate image with figure, heading, parent procedure and original page crop; require model verification against the image for image-dependent claims

Even a high-scoring semantic verifier can make mistakes; guarantee only that the application follows the fail-closed protocol, not that all semantic classifications are infallible. Output citations must map to immutable evidence object IDs, not model-created page numbers.
